notes.title: 2021 5/10 Game Update
notes.notes:
This version contains multiple updates:
1. The music is fully replaced with an 8-bit style version.
2. Some art pictures are redrawn.
3. The addition or modification of certain sound effects.
4. Some storylines have been re-adapted and translated. (Especially the heroine) 
5. Two new achievements have been added, and the glitch that will crash when double knockout with the enemy boss is fixed.
